hardware: Assumed 1 NVIDIA A100 80GB plus host CPU
pipeline: Warm asynchronous vLLM layout segmentation + crop recognition; no speculative decoding
batch: Queued pages and concurrent crops, tuned to fit memory; not single-page latency
workload: Typical scanned document pages to Markdown; dense tables, very long pages and graphics-heavy output can be slower
basis: Pipeline-class planning envelope, not parameter scaling. Paddle authors measured MonkeyOCR-pro1.2B at0.673 and PaddleOCR-VL at1.3453 pages/s on one A100, vLLM0.10.2,512PDF paths, OmniDocBench1.0. TeleOCR also splits layout and region recognition. Approximately one-third of the slower anchor to three times the faster anchor, rounded to0.2–4. Multipliers are explicitly judgmental, not fitted.
limitations: No TeleOCR A100 page run or statistical coverage validation. Separate exact-model community q4f16 Radeon8060S timings (65–90 decode tokens/s,0.13–2.1s TTFT) are NOT normalized to A100: with6–21 calls,1000–4000 total generated tokens and1–5s overhead, they imply only≈0.009–0.08 pages/s serially. Different hardware, quantization and batching explain why that is a different scenario.

pipeline: Warm compiled Transformers baseline from exact-model runtime author; no NInfer/MTP acceleration
workload: 1000–3000 generated tokens/page,0.2–2s combined image prefill/I/O; total input+output context must fit4096tokens
basis: 1/(overhead + output tokens/decode rate). Exact-model runtime author reports162.3–166.4 decode tokens/s on three small samples; endpoint assumptions give≈0.049–0.161 pages/s.
limitations: Token microbenchmarks are not measured full-page throughput. Overhead/output budgets are analyst scenarios; large images or longer pages can fall outside. The faster717–719tok/s speculative NInfer result is deliberately not substituted.

pipeline: Official vLLM>=0.11.0, single tensor-parallel GPU, BF16/FlashAttention2. Document-parsing prompt; NOT SVG generation.
precision: Assumed BF16 weights and KV cache
batch: Warm queued pages/crops, concurrency tuned to memory; analogue batch unspecified unless stated
workload: Typical document parsing to Markdown/JSON; not SVG generation or extreme page lengths
basis: Pinned dots.mocr and dots.ocr config JSON is identical (28-layer1536-wide decoder,42-layer1536-wide vision encoder). LightOn authors measured original dots.ocr0.88pages/s on1H10080GB BF16 over1403olmOCR-Bench pages. Apply a judgmental roughly quarter-to-double allowance for changed weights/output lengths/rendering, rounded to0.2–1.8. No same-checkpoint measurement.
limitations: Same architecture is unusually strong transfer evidence, not equal throughput. Graphic/SVG outputs can be far longer than standard OCR and fall outside this interval. Range multipliers are judgmental, not measured or statistically calibrated.

hardware: Assumed NVIDIA A100 plus host CPU

precision: Source precision unspecified; assume its standard Paddle configuration
workload: One scanned text page treated as one raster image; text-only output, no layout/table/formula reconstruction

limitations: The four-to-one slow-side allowance and two-to-one fast-side allowance are not calibrated. Dense text/high-resolution pages may be slower. Other models may perform much more document-structure work; this is not an equivalent output task.

hardware: Assumed x86 CPU setup with4vCPUs per engine; no GPU
pipeline: Indra1.1 auto: PDF text layer plus OCR; no --math
batch: One warm engine processing pages serially
workload: Mixed born-digital/scanned pages similar to OmniParseBench; uses PDF text when available
basis: Exact-mode author median is0.212s/page on2937pages, varying about15% across runs. A planning mean-latency scenario of0.2–2s/page yields0.5–5pages/s. The upper latency allowance is a judgment for long tails, NOT an inferred mean or confidence interval.
limitations: Reciprocal median is not aggregate throughput. This estimate assumes the average lies within the explicit scenario; extreme long tails or all-scanned content may violate it. OCR-only32core throughput is a different mode and is not substituted. The auto accuracy row can use digital PDF text unavailable to image-only models.
